adrs.title: The first decision, later taken again
adrs.body:
## Context and Problem Statement

Something had to be decided, and this is what was decided.

## Decision Outcome

It held for two months.

adrs.title: A decision the whole context keeps
adrs.body:
## Context and Problem Statement

A context is not a service, and a decision at that level binds every service
in it.

## Decision Outcome

Kept.
adrs.note: the half of this about retries was decided again in acme.0003, which is not the same as this record being superseded.

adrs.title: The decision that replaced the first one
adrs.body:
## Context and Problem Statement

Two months of it holding was not the same as it being right.

### A heading further down

The body is carried through untouched, headings and all.

## Decision Outcome

Replaced.

adrs.title: A decision nobody in particular owns
adrs.body:
## Context and Problem Statement

Some decisions belong to the organisation and to no service in it.

## Decision Outcome

Proposed, and still open.
